game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk, a cracked obelisk: the rune scholar must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Stat Market: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk: a cracked obelisk
core_gameplay_loop: In Cracked Obelisk, repeat each round: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades. Each round, crypt crawlers strike the sealed archway, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sealed archway from crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk: keep the profit meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: profit drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Stat Market
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stat Market' (Week 7 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cracked Obelisk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while profit > 0.
